ask.confirmTitle.note: The title of a confirmation dialog (OK/Cancel) that doesn't give a title of its own.

ask.title.note: The title of a notice or a text prompt that doesn't give a title of its own: the product's name.

ask.ok.note: The confirm button of the page's dialogs (questions, notices, text prompts) that don't name their own action.

ask.cancel.note: The button that dismisses one of the page's questions or text prompts without doing anything (Esc does the same).
